title: Add debounce(fn, ms) with cancel()

brief.goal: Add `debounce` to src/timing.ts: the returned function calls fn once with the latest arguments after ms milliseconds without further calls; it exposes cancel() to drop a pending call.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
Use setTimeout/clearTimeout so the test can use node:test mock timers
acceptanceCriteria: calling the debounced function twice within ms results in one call with the last arguments
no call happens before ms has elapsed
the existing throttle test keeps passing

expected_clean_output: debounce with trailing-edge semantics and cancel(); mock-timer grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: The debounced function fires on the leading edge as well, so fn runs immediately on the first call.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: calls is [1] before any time has passed.
